correctness.rationale: Reconstructed elimination of the y,z equilibrium equations with denominator D=2x²+rho*x+5-rho², including exceptional D=0/x=0 fibers. Independent SymPy exact algebra verifies disc_x(P)=12000Q, the quartic root samples have respectively 4,2,0 real roots for rho=-3,-3/2,-1, Q has isolated simple negative roots, and at rho=-2 P=(x-2)(8x³-9x+4). For the explicit sink (2,2,0), the Jacobian has lambda³+8lambda²+11lambda+20 (strict cubic Hurwitz). The negative cubic root produces a second sink by the stated positive B,C,8B-C interval bounds; an independent symbolic reduction of its characteristic coefficients modulo 8t³-9t-4 corroborated the certificate. No global attractor claim follows.
